Root .gitignore already ignores .env, .env.* (except .env.example), *.env, node_modules/, dist/, build/, .next/, out/, and backend/tests/. Keep secrets out of git. Backend is complete; only fix it if a rubric point (BE1-BE5) is genuinely broken. Match the backend API contract exactly.
key_patterns: Response envelope (backend/src/utils/response.ts): success {success:true,message,data?}; paginated {success:true,message,data:[...],pagination:{page,limit,total,totalPages}}; error {success:false,message,errors?} with errors=[{field,location,message}] for Zod. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <token>; login/register return data.user + data.accessToken; GET /api/auth/me returns the user directly in data; JWT payload {id,name,email,role}; 1d expiry; inactive users rejected. Roles: admin, kasir, mekanik, pemilik, pelanggan. Status flow (constants/index.ts ALLOWED_STATUS_TRANSITIONS): Antre->[Diperiksa,Dibatalkan], Diperiksa->[Dikerjakan], Dikerjakan->[Selesai], Selesai->[Diambil], Diambil->[], Dibatalkan->[]. Only admin/kasir may set Diambil; Diperiksa requires a mechanic already assigned; a mekanik may act only on tickets assigned to them; parts add/remove only in Diperiksa/Dikerjakan and auto-adjust stock. Invoice PDF (GET /api/bookings/:id/invoice/pdf) streams application/pdf only after Diambil, for admin/kasir/pemilik or the owning online pelanggan. Email is fully automatic server-side (confirmation on online booking, completion email when an online ticket reaches Selesai) - the frontend only SURFACES it. Services GET endpoints are PUBLIC; parts GET requires auth. Dashboard/revenue reports are admin/pemilik only and use Asia/Jakarta day boundaries.
